notes.title: Bhru Bheda (Eyebrow Movement)
notes.body:
Shloka :
Atha granthantha-rastha bhru bheda nirupyanthe
Sahaja patita utkshipta chatura rechita tathaa  Kunchiteti 
Shadevaatra bhru chaturyavathi kriyaah 

1. Sahaja - Eyebrows straight (natural) without any movement
2. Patita - Brows being at rest, are brought closer downwards
3. Utkshipta - Both of the eye brows are raised
4. Chatura - Moving both the eyebrows up and down slightly
5. Rechitha - Raising one eyebrow
6. Kunchita - 	Bending both eyebrows

notes.title: Greeva Bheda (Neck Movements)
notes.body:
Shloka
Atha chaturvida greeva bheda nirupyanthe
Sundari Tirashchinai Parivartita Prakampita cha 
bhavagnair gneya greeva chaturvidha

1. Sundari : Here the neck is moved from side to side. It is also called as Attami.
2. Tirashchina: Here neck is moved in a V-shape (top to bottom).
3. Prarivartita: Here the neck is moved in a Semicircle or moonlike shape.
4. Prakampita: Here the neck is moved forward and back.

notes.title: Dhrishti Bheda (Eye Movements)
notes.body:
Shloka :
Atha ashta drishti bheda lakshanyai
Samam Alokitam Saachi pralokitam Nimilitam
Ullokitam anuvrittam avalokitam
ithi ashta drishti bhedasthu krirthithe bharathagame

1. Sama:  Eye kept still without any movement.
2. Alokita: Rolling your eye balls in a circular pattern.
3. Saachi: Looking through the corner of the eyes.
4. Pralokita: moving your eyes side to side.
5. Nimilita:  It looks like a half shut eye.
6. Ullokita: Looking upwards.
7. Anuvritta: Rapid movement of the eyes up and down.
8. Avalokita: Looking down.

notes.title: Shiro Bheda (Head Movements)
notes.body:
Shloka :
Atha nava-vidha shirobheda lakshanyai
Samam udvahitam adhomukham alolitam Dhutam
kampitam cha paravrittam ukshiptam parivahitam
navdha-kathitam shirasam natyashastra visharadaihi.

1. Sama : The head kept straight
2. Udvahitam : Head Looking upwards
3. Adhomukham : Looking Down
4. Alolitam: Circular Movement of the head
5. Dhutam: Right to left movement of the head
6. Kampitam: Up and down nod of the head
7. Paravrittam: Brisk turning of the head to the right or left
8. Ukshiptam: Head is turned and raised or a slanting position of the head.
9. Parivahittam: Quick small shakes of the head.
